title: Quantum Startups Report First Error-Corrected Qubits
summary: Logical qubits stay stable long enough for small algorithms.

body.text: Further details are expected at a briefing scheduled for later this month.
Early reactions from the community have been broadly positive, though some raised questions about timing.
This changes the baseline for everyone.
Supporters point to similar efforts abroad that delivered results within a few years.
Critics argue the numbers are promising but still need to be confirmed at larger scale.

author.name: Tom Okafor
author.bio: Developer tools and open source reporter.
